verses.text: So love Yahweh your God. Always keep his instructions, laws, rulings, and commands.
Remember this today. I’m speaking to you because your children didn’t experience or see Yahweh your God’s discipline, his greatness, his mighty hand, or his outstretched arm.
They didn’t see the signs and deeds he did in Egypt against Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and his whole land.

They didn’t see what he did to Egypt’s army, its horses, and its chariots. He swept the waters of the Red Sea over them as they were chasing you. To this day, they’re gone because Yahweh destroyed them.
They didn’t see what he did for you in the wilderness until you came here.

They didn’t see what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab son of Reuben. Right in the middle of Israel, the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households, their tents, and every living thing following them.
But you saw with your own eyes every great thing Yahweh did.
So keep every command I’m giving you today. Then you’ll be strong enough to cross over and take possession of the land you’re heading into.
You’ll live long in the land Yahweh promised your ancestors and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.
The land you’re about to take over is different from Egypt, where you came from. There you planted seed and watered it by foot like a vegetable garden.
The land you’re crossing into has hills and valleys that drink up rain straight from the sky.
Yahweh your God cares for that land. His eyes are on it all year, from the first day to the last.
If you listen closely to the commands I’m giving you today and love Yahweh your God and serve him with your whole heart and soul,
then I’ll send rain on your land at the proper time, both early and late rains. You’ll bring in your grain, new wine, and oil.
I’ll grow grass in your fields for your livestock, and you’ll eat your fill.
Watch out that your heart isn’t fooled into turning away to serve other gods and bow down to them.
If you do that, Yahweh’s anger will flare against you. He’ll shut the sky so it won’t rain and the land won’t grow crops. You’ll quickly perish from the good land he’s giving you.
Keep these words of mine in your heart and soul. Tie them as a sign on your hand and wear them between your eyes.
Teach them to your children. Talk about them when you sit at home, when you walk along the road, when you lie down, and when you get up.
Write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.
Then you and your children will live many days in the land Yahweh promised your ancestors, as long as the heavens are over the earth.
If you take care to follow all the commands I’m giving you, loving Yahweh your God, walking in all his ways, and holding tight to him,
Yahweh will drive all these nations out ahead of you, and you’ll take land from nations bigger and stronger than you.
Every place you set foot will be yours. Your borders will run from the wilderness to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates River to the western sea.
Nobody will be able to stand against you. Yahweh your God will make people afraid of you throughout the land you tread on, just as he told you.
Look, today I’m putting a blessing and a curse in front of you.
The blessing is yours if you listen to the commands of Yahweh your God that I’m giving you today.
The curse comes if you refuse to listen to Yahweh your God’s commands and turn away from the path I’m giving you today to chase after gods you’ve never known.
When Yahweh your God brings you into the land you’re going to own, put the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
Aren’t those mountains across the Jordan, beyond the road toward the sunset, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah near Gilgal, next to the oaks of Moreh?
You’re going to cross the Jordan to take the land Yahweh your God is giving you. You’ll take possession of it and live there.
Be careful to put into practice all the laws and rulings I’m setting before you today.
